decisions.statement: A page is named by its page type and the slug that page is filed under.
A gap is named by the statement that gap states rather than by its place.
A name that is no page is refused.
A call naming other than two words is refused.
A statement of no text is refused.
A statement no gap of that page states is refused here rather than by the change.
A decision of another kind stating that text is no gap, so the call is refused.
A statement more than one decision states is refused by the change rather than here.
Taking the gap out is left to the mechanical change taking a record out.
A run says the commit that run landed.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
A change that refused is a fault of the data.
Nothing here asks Alan to confirm.
No check runs over the change a run lands.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.

definition: the command taking one gap out of the decisions the page stating it holds
